text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's showdown time with Dober from<n>the Mejiro
family! Even if the divine<n>dares to claim that
differences in the<n>environment one is raised in
leads to<n>differences in strength—I disagree!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll win this race to prove that the<n>bonds you form
with other people can<n>be even stronger than familial
bonds!
